November 12, 2026


## On November 12,[Teekay Corporation](http://teekay.com/investors/teekay-corporation/financials-presentations/) and[Teekay Tankers](http://teekay.com/investors/teekay-tankers-ltd/) released their Q3-2026 earnings results.


The Teekay Group delivered another strong third-quarter 2026 results, driven by a combination of


elevated refinery margins, resilient global oil demand, low refined product inventories, and ongoing geopolitical disruptions that have increased transportation requirements.


A combination of rising crude oil exports from the Atlantic Basin since the start of the year coupled with the more recent recovery in supply out of the Middle East Gulf has


pushed


global crude oil trade volumes


back


above pre-war levels


in recent weeks,


boosting crude tanker demand.


Since reporting last


quarter’s


results,


we


have


entered


into newbuild contract


s


for two Chinese-built LR2 vessels


and


two Korean-built Suezmax tankers


with options for two more


Suezmaxes


, all for


deliver


ies


in 2030


. Along with our previously-announced Suezmax tanker newbuild


ings, Teekay Tankers


now has


a


total of


six vessels on order


delivering


in


mid-2027


and


throug


h


2030


.


In addition, we have agreed to acquire a modern MR tanker, which expands our footprint into an adjacent sector where we have an ownership history, and we believe we can leverage our integrated operating platform.


While the near-term tanker market will remain sensitive to geopolitical developments, Teekay Tankers enters the fourth quarter from a position of exceptional strength. With record rates booked to date, a low cash flow break-even, a debt-free balance sheet and significant investment capacity, we are well positioned to deliver record results in 2026, continue renewing our fleet


,


and create long-term value for our shareholders.
